loopback.title: DZBuild POS
loopback.done: Signed in. Go back to DZBuild POS to finish linking.
loopback.failed: The sign-in did not complete. Go back to DZBuild POS to try again.

intro: Linking is optional, and DZBuild POS stays free with or without it. Linked to your DZBuild account, your shop gets its own website and online store on dzbuild.com: your catalogue and stock are published there, and online orders reach the till. The till, stock, documents and backups keep working without the link and without internet.
till: This till sells with the main PC “{{host}}”: the DZBuild link and its settings are managed on the main PC.

notices.title: Good to know
notices.cloud_not_ready: {{subject}}: not available yet at DZBuild. Everything is kept; the till tries again every day.
notices.cloud_plan_cap: Your DZBuild plan limits online products: the next ones stay as drafts ({{drafted}}).
notices.cloud_plan_cap_kind: {{subject}}: your DZBuild plan does not include it. Nothing is lost; the till tries again every day.
notices.cloud_plan_cap_event: Your DZBuild plan does not let the till take {{event}}: change your plan on DZBuild.
notices.online_price_changed: The price of “{{product}}” was changed on DZBuild: the till keeps its own. Change it in the product if needed.
notices.cloud_credential_kept: The link is stopped, but its access key could not be erased from Windows Credential Manager. Link the same store again: the key will be replaced.
notices.cloud_conflict_online_wins: “{{product}}” was changed online and at the till: the online change is kept.
notices.online_product_deleted: “{{product}}” was deleted from the online store: it is no longer published.
notices.online_price_ht_shop: The price of “{{product}}” was changed online; your shop shows prices before tax: check it in the product.
notices.online_order_changed: Order {{subject}} changed online after it was prepared: check it.
notices.cloud_order_claimed_elsewhere: Order {{subject}} is being prepared by another device.
notices.online_order_fulfilled_claimed_elsewhere: Order {{subject}} was sold or shipped here, but DZBuild gave it to another device: tell that device so it is not prepared twice.
notices.online_order_returned_in_shop: Return {{document}} is for an online order: it is not sent to DZBuild. Update the order on DZBuild.
notices.cloud_refund_unmatched: Credit note {{subject}} covers several delivery notes ({{deliveries}}): it is not sent to DZBuild. Record the refund on DZBuild.
notices.cloud_relink_required: Link needed again: link the same store again.
notices.cloud_revoked: This till was removed from DZBuild.
notices.cloud_event_unreadable: This version could not read a change sent by DZBuild, so it skipped it. Update DZBuild POS.
notices.cloud_product_refused: “{{subject}}” was edited on DZBuild but the till did not take the change: correct it on DZBuild. Reason: {{reason}}
notices.cloud_variant_refused: DZBuild did not accept {{count}} variant(s) of “{{product}}”. Reason: {{reason}}
notices.cloud_order_refused: Order {{subject}} from DZBuild could not be recorded at the till: check it on DZBuild. Reason: {{reason}}
notices.cloud_event_refused: DZBuild sent {{event}} that the till could not take. Reason: {{reason}}
notices.stock_double_applied: DZBuild also deducted the stock of an in-store sale: the stock of its products will be sent again.
